input.sql: SELECT s.School, s.CharterNum, AVG(ss.AvgScrWrite) as AvgWritingScore FROM satscores ss JOIN schools s ON ss.cds = s.CDSCode WHERE ss.AvgScrWrite > 499 AND s.CharterNum IS NOT NULL GROUP BY s.School, s.CharterNum ORDER BY AvgWritingScore DESC
